crossRefs.note: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in…
He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens.…
My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

translations.web: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

translations.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
